PRIVACY POLICY

How we handle your information

This policy explains the information Cyberfreak Software Limited uses, why we use it and the choices available to you.

Last updated: 17 November 2026

Cyberfreak Software Limited (“CFS”, “we”, “us” or “our”) handles personal information responsibly. This policy covers this website, contact-form enquiries and information we use to provide SEO Management, Website Deployments and software services.

Information we use

When you contact us, we may receive your name, email address, business or website details, the subject and message you submit, and the page from which the enquiry was sent. For agreed services, the information may include client contacts, website and domain details, correspondence, service records and access information needed for the work.

SEO Management can involve Google Search Console performance data, search queries, clicks, impressions, indexed-page information, sitemap or verification details and monthly reports. We use these only to configure and provide the agreed monitoring service, analyse performance and prepare reports or recommendations.

Why we use it

We use information to respond to enquiries, provide agreed services, communicate with customers, administer our business records, protect our systems and meet legal obligations. Depending on the context, we rely on taking steps at your request before a contract, performing a contract, a legal obligation, or our legitimate interests in operating and protecting a professional services business. We do not sell personal information or use contact-form submissions for solely automated decisions.

Access and sharing

Access is limited to people who need it to respond to an enquiry, deliver or support a service, or meet legal obligations. Our contact form sends submissions to the existing CFS contact service. SEO Management information may also be available in customer-authorised Google Search Console, website, hosting or domain services. Those providers process information under their own terms and privacy documentation.

Retention and security

We keep information only as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, including providing services and meeting business or legal obligations. We use reasonable organisational and technical measures to protect it. Do not send passwords or unnecessary sensitive information through the contact form.

Your rights

Subject to applicable law, you may ask for access, correction, erasure, restriction or portability of your personal information, or object to certain processing. Contact us through the website and select “Privacy question”. You may also raise a concern with the UK Information Commissioner’s Office.

Changes

We may update this policy if our services, systems or legal obligations change. The current version will remain available here. Read our Terms of Service for the related service framework.
